title: Mystic Wands
description: This is a simple minecraft plugin that adds mana and a WHOLE TON OF COOL WANDS TO HAVE FUN WITH
body:
Got it! Here's the corrected Modrinth description with /wand reload removed and everything aligned to your actual command set:

MysticWands is a cinematic magic plugin for Minecraft 1.20.1 that empowers players with spell-casting wands, dynamic mana tracking, and immersive visual effects. Each wand casts a unique spell with particles, sounds, and mana costs, making it perfect for RPG or fantasy-themed servers.
Commands:
- /wand list — View all available wands
- /wand give <type> — Receive a wand of the specified type (e.g., /wand give fire)
- /wand mana — Check your current mana level
Available wand types:
- fire — Casts a fireball (Mana cost: 20)
- lightning — Summons a lightning strike (Mana cost: 25)
- teleport — Teleports the player forward (Mana cost: 30)
- healing — Restores health (Mana cost: 15)
- ice — Freezes enemies in place (Mana cost: 20)
- destruction — Triggers a powerful explosion (Mana cost: 40)
Mana regenerates over time and is displayed as a boss bar at the top of the screen. Each spell includes custom particles and sound effects for maximum immersion. MysticWands is modular, lightweight, and designed for easy integration into any server looking to add a touch of magic.
